scope: Train-only joint background and temporal-excitation comparison on80 existing S04B histories, conditional on fixed spatial and mark laws; no new histories, physical claim, global optimum, asymptotic inference or prospective validity.
bounds_source: Shared OC bounds: engine/stage2_followup/s03_s06_spatial_benchmarks/s06/engine.py; inhibition bounds: reproduction/synthetic/source/controls_campaign.py. These are adopted as the new common protocol, not asserted to be historical S04B nuisance fits.
fixed: beta=2,r=.7,sigma=10; exact generating spatial law, nine rectangles/reference pi and smooth mixture centres/weights/bandwidth from pinned generator.fitting_metadata. No spatial/mark fitting.

split.rule: Half-open intervals. All strictly earlier parents including warmup; tied events do not parent one another. Training selection cannot read test scores. Test is scored after all training selections are fixed.

starts.alternative_start_zero: Use selected new null shared coordinates for eta0 start; positive starts1..7 use the same corresponding shared templates as the null. Exact selected new null is additionally an eligible unoptimized alternative state.

solver.rescue: Failure-only bounded Powell from finite feasible failed returned point, otherwise original start. A finite objective with unrepresentable gradient may use value-only Powell; primary arithmetic failure is retained. Timeout, memory, interruption and programming errors stop without recovery.
solver.completion: Every one of8 starts must resolve with finite feasible successful result; all attempts, failures, caps and messages retained. Any unresolved start makes arm/case unknown and stops campaign; never zero gain.
solver.selected_acceptance: Eight resolved starts, finite feasible fresh-selected value/gradient and declared quadrature consistency. Projected KKT norm is reported as a diagnostic; no added arbitrary KKT threshold or claim of optimum/global stationarity.

quadrature.time_plan: Fixed before optimization; log panels within every event gap use c_min=.0001, independent of fitted c. No derivative of moving quadrature nodes.
quadrature.space_plan: Pinned geometry-only adaptive positive area plan, proxy tolerance1e-8, near width20. Background masses calibrated; attenuation never renormalized.
quadrature.training: Fit order8/64, preserve that selection. Verify selected null and three alternatives at16/128 without re-ranking; require alternative fine NLL no worse than eligible null beyond1e-9. Record projected KKT and scaled coarse/fine projected-gradient difference, not a raw boundary-gradient condition.
quadrature.test: After training frozen, report fine16/128 scores and separately evaluate8/64 as a declared numerical sensitivity check, never for selection.
quadrature.failure: Any selected coarse/fine joint or training-gradient failure stops as numerical unknown. No automatic tolerance relaxation or outcome-triggered refit.
quadrature.exposure_sign: Selected fine training/test exposure estimates must be nonnegative; no clipped negative exposure. Trial arithmetic failure is retained under the declared recovery policy.

historical_checks.source: Exact full-precision archived phase/state payload and refitted-floor per-history JSON, never rounded PDF values. These checks concern identical uninhibited floor and saved comparison identities, not replay of every historical inhibited quadrature.
historical_checks.meaning: 480 are recomputed identical phase/model floor checks.400 are full-precision saved comparison identities, not new historical inhibited likelihood evaluations.

gates.rule: New selected null train nll minus new alternative train nll must be strictly greater than threshold; otherwise select exact stored new null. Historical gate states are comparators only.
gates.tie_selection: Exact nll ties prefer eligible new-null state, then lower start index.
gates.win: gain>0 strictly; exact floor-return gain=0 and non-win.
gates.near_zero: abs(gain)<=1e-9 separately; positive near-zero gains remain strict wins and are separately censused.
gates.off_floor: selected eta>0; distinguish eta0 optimized shared coordinates from exact stored null return.
gates.score_order: Gate uses consistent fine16/128 training scores at frozen coarse-selected verified states. Retain coarse training gain, fine gain, each threshold distance and coarse/fine disagreement flag; no hidden selection flip.

reporting: All20 regime/procedure rows: N,mean,median,wins Wilson95%, strict/nearzero/robust sign, a/eta/allcoordinate boundaries, solverunknowns, off_floor, selectedstateindex, thinning counters. S5/S7 count-suppressed weak-geometry strata remain separate; no structural nonidentification claim. P+signedC+M=joint; E=-C.

resources.owner: Conductor enforces wall and sampled process-tree RSS termination under an exclusive numerical lease attestation; not an OS hard allocation limit. Wrapper checks deadlines and conservative local allocation estimates. Full reuses5 passed pilot cases and adds75; no replacements.
resources.full_admission: Pilot5 scientific gates pass. For each phase, proxy_ns=max observed pilot(space_nodes/(parents+1))*(case parents+1), proxy_nt=128*(case targets+1), W=sum(proxy_ns*proxy_nt*(parents+1)) over train/test. Full projection=3*max(pilot case elapsed/W)*sum(all80 W), must be<=14400 including pilot. This input-dimension proxy is an admission heuristic, not a runtime guarantee; actual hard wall and sampled RSS controls remain active. No gain-based selection.

pilot_extra_selection.rule: Unique largest Ntrain*parents_before395 among fixed80 histories, before any new fit

remaining_contrasts: Other18 regime/procedure comparisons descriptive; pointwise Wilson intervals are not simultaneous coverage.
null_floor: Exact feasible historical backbone is an eligible new-null candidate; selected new null cannot be worse beyond1e-9.
null_search_gap: Every eta0 optimized alternative that improves training NLL over the new-null candidate by>1e-9 is recorded as a null-search gap. Such a procedure contrast is not labelled an active-inhibition gain. Case-level existence of a gap is flagged on all outcomes of that alternative.
runtime_reuse: Pilot/full require identical Python version/implementation/executable hash, NumPy/SciPy versions, architecture/byte order, NumPy core and SciPy L-BFGS-B extension hashes, new source/input hashes and the exact same compiled native library hash. Detailed platform/kernel/build metadata are retained separately and may differ across fresh CI runners; original pilot runtime is retained in full result. No numerical tolerance is relaxed. Loaded numerical-library binary hashes also match, independently of installation path.
